note: v2, 3:43.2–4:10.9 (it runs into window 9): at the top of the fifteenth walk two more guitars say the phrase of 80 a storey under the number and the bass says the phrase of 40; the left guitar joins the pair at 80 and the pair stops at 40. China and a crash for the ten bars of 160.

v9 (chirper-zero): somebody counts the way home. From forty (4:10.8) a voice says each number where it begins; five more voices say the sixteenth walk; on the wheel one word a turn, the last word of the song is "one".

v19 (chirper-two): the wheel, 4:26.7-4:38.8. The horn comes down its tube on it, eight, four, two, one (F4, F3, F2, the low F), each for that many turns of the wheel; the two bells keep its time, F on four and two, C on one, low low high in seven against the kit; the bell rings the next four on the last chord. No stroke of the band, the ondes or the count changes.
